subject: Updated MAP: Data handling commitments & target dates
body_summary: Post-call follow-up sharing a MAP draft focused on data handling. Customer asks for clarifications about KMS, retention window segmentation for PHI, and sample audit log format. Internal owners assigned: Redwood to produce audit-log sample and retention config note, Sales to coordinate procurement. Target close date proposed: 2026-11-19; customer decision window requested by 2026-11-05. Next step: technical deep-dive with customer's security lead (Phil) and procurement checkpoint.
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medlytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft: data handling milestones

Thanks again for your time earlier today — good convo. Per our call I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the data-handling and compliance milestones we discussed. High-level recap and asks below so we have alignment before the technical follow-up: 

Key MAP milestones (draft):
- M1 — Retention policy & scoping (owner: MedLytics) — define retention windows for PHI vs non-PHI; target: 2026-11-05 (customer decision)
- M2 — Audit logging & access trails (owner: Redwood) — provide sample log schema, retention options, and delivery cadence; target: 2026-11-12
- M3 — Encryption & key management (owner: customer preference) — confirm if you require customer-managed KMS (BYOK) or Redwood-managed; target: 2026-11-12
- M4 — Contract & PHI addendum (owner: Procurement / Redwood legal) — redlines and DPA/BAA agreement; target close: 2026-11-19

Dependencies we flagged: security review (MedLytics), procurement timeline, and DocuSign routing for BAA.

Quick asks for you: please confirm (a) who will own M1 on your side (name + email), (b) whether BYOK is required, and (c) whether Nov 19 is reasonable for target close.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones), audit-evidence-stub.pdf (sample log extract & field definitions).

Next steps I propose: 30-min technical session with Phil (security lead) next week to walk the audit log sample and retention options; procurement checkpoint (15 min) week of 11/08 to review contract items.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Phil Turner <phil.turner@medlytics.com>, Procurement <procure@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: data handling milestones

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the clear note and the draft MAP. A few clarifying questions from our side before we loop in legal/procurement: 

1) KMS: Do you support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS BYOK)? If yes, what is the integration model (Cloud KMS only or HSM via partner)?
2) PHI scoping: Can Redwood support retention subsetting so that PHI records follow a different retention pipeline from non-PHI? We need to ensure that de-identification or tokenization options are available as an alternative to storing PHI long-term.
3) Audit logs: can you share a sample event schema and indicate retention granularity (per-event, per-session) and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM?
4) Compliance evidence: please attach your most recent SOC 2 Type II and a short sample of what an audit log export looks like (CSV/JSON with field defs).

Our procurement team is asking for an internal decision date — we're aiming to commit to next steps by 2026-11-05. Phil (CC'd) will join the technical session.

Elena Soto
Director, Platform Security | MedLytics
elena.soto@medlytics.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: data handling milestones

Forwarding Elena's clarifying questions — action items below.

Elena asks for: KMS model details, PHI retention subsetting options, sample audit log schema, and SOC2 Type II evidence.

Please respond to the owners below and I will send the consolidated reply + updated MAP back to MedLytics by Friday (10/30):
- Action (Redwood Tech): Monica -> draft a 1-page tech note: sample audit-log schema (fields + retention granularity), export options (S3, syslog, SIEM connectors), and brief on how we implement retention buckets (incl. PHI subsetting). ETA: 2026-10-30 EOD.
- Action (Sales): Ben -> prepare standard PHI clause language + recommended redlines for a BAA/DPA and confirm our BA compliance posture. Also coordinate with Legal on BYOK capabilities and limitations. ETA: 2026-11-03.
- Action (Sales Eng): Vivek -> schedule 30-min technical deep dive with Phil for 2026-11-02; include Monica and an infra engineer if available.

Proposed MAP milestone refresh (short names + owners):
* Retention scope confirmation (Owner: MedLytics) — decision by 2026-11-05
* Audit log sample & export options (Owner: Redwood/Monica) — deliver 2026-10-30
* KMS approach and constraints (Owner: Redwood Legal/Ben) — confirm by 2026-11-12
* Contract + BAA execution (Owner: Procurement + Redwood Legal) — target close 2026-11-19

Dependencies: SOC2 evidence pack availability, customer's SIEM requirements, and procurement signature flow.

Let me know if owners/ETAs above look realistic. I will draft the consolidated reply to Elena once I have Monica's log sample.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medlytics.com>
Cc: Phil Turner <phil.turner@medlytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & next steps (audit sample attached)

Elena — thanks for the quick turn. Attaching the requested artifacts and an updated MAP view. Below are firmed-up confirmations based on internal info: 

1) KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys for our Private deployments and can integrate with cloud KMS (GCP KMS / AWS KMS). For hosted customers we offer BYOK via customer KMS integration; if an HSM-on-prem requirement exists we'll scope an engagement. (Owner: Ben/Legal)

2) PHI retention subsetting: we support retention buckets and tagged record-level retention policies so PHI can be routed to a tighter retention pipeline or subject to automated deletion. We also support inline tokenization integration partners if you prefer not to store raw PHI. (Owner: MedLytics to confirm scope; Redwood implementation notes attached)

3) Audit logs: attached is a short sample (audit-evidence-stub.pdf) showing event schema (timestamp, request_id, user_id, model, input_hash, action, outcome, ip, geo, keystore_id) and export options (S3, syslog, SIEM connector). Logs can be retained for configurable durations per account and exported on schedule. (Owner: Monica)

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, audit-evidence-stub.pdf, SOC2-summary-link (drive).

Next steps I propose:
- Technical deep-dive with Phil: 2026-11-02 10:00-10:30 PT (please confirm)
- Procurement checkpoint: 2026-11-08 (15 min) to review contract redlines and BAA
- Target mutual close date: 2026-11-19

If that timeline works I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and route a DocuSign for the BAA when legal confirms redlines. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5948392/DEAL-2026-1147

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
